title: Result recycle bin
description: Restore removed test records and their associated reports
scopeHint: Removal only changes the records visible in this client and can be undone. It does not reclaim disk space or change data on remote nodes.
loadFailed: Could not load the recycle bin. Try again.
emptyHint: Removed test records appear here and can be restored together with their associated reports.
restoreFailed: Could not restore this record. It remains in the recycle bin. Try again.
restoredRefreshFailed: The record was restored, but other pages could not refresh. Refresh the affected pages later.
confirmDescription: The entire owning test execution and its associated reports will be removed together from this client's lists and overview. You can restore them from the recycle bin.
remoteHint: Data on remote nodes remains unchanged.
localHint: This can be undone and does not reclaim disk space.

blocked.active: The test is still running. Stop or cancel it and wait for it to finish before removing it.
blocked.unconfirmed: The task state is not confirmed. Wait for confirmation before removing it.

movedRefreshFailed: The record was moved to the recycle bin, but some views could not refresh. Refresh the affected lists.
moveFailed: Could not move this record to the recycle bin. Try again.
